The '''Uviuy Exen system''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|same name]] and lay at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], which led various [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along those routes to pass through the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Uviuy Exen system remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and eventually became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Later, Uviuy Exen was the site of [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|several]] [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|battles]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].

==Description==
The Uviuy Exen system was located in the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]].<ref name="IS2" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] lay at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;the minor [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> known as the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]], which linked Uviuy Exen to the [[Dankayo system/Legends|Dankayo system]], and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the [[Eeropha system|Eeropha]] and [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], a number of early hyperlanes connected the Uviuy Exen system to the systems of [[Chagri system|Chagri]], [[Nouane system/Legends|Nouane]], [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa]], [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal]], [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Palanhi system/Legends|Palanhi]];<ref name="TEA" /> however, by [[17,000 BBY]], these had coalesced into a single route running from Chagri to Brentaal through Uviuy Exen.<ref name="EGtW" /> That hyperlane would eventually be known as the [[Corsin Run]], which had been merged into the modern Hydian Way by [[3694 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Conflicts and changes of government===
[[File:UviuyExen22kBBY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Uviuy Exen system was a part of the Galactic Republic by 22,000 BBY.]]
Although [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Uviuy Exen system only became well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the system had already been incorporated into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By 17,000 BBY, Uviuy Exen had allied with the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in its [[First Alsakan Conflict|struggle]] against [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the status of the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]],<ref name="EGtW" /> yet it remained in space loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Early in that conflict, the Uviuy Exen system lay at the intersection of territories that the [[First Army|First]], [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third]], and [[Seventh Army|Seventh Armies]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] were tasked with defending against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGtW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], the Uviuy Exen system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Uviuy Exen system fell under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|defeated]] the [[Zsinj's Empire|forces]] of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] at Uviuy Exen in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] as part of a drive to push Imperials up the Hydian Way,<ref name="EGtW" /> and the star system had fallen under New Republic control that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. However, [[10 ABY/Legends|four years]] later, [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|another battle]] was fought at Uviuy Exen when Imperials advanced from the Chagri system to the Brentaal system. The population of the Uviuy Exen system numbered between 500 million and 1 billion around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

===A system at a crossroads===
Due to its strategic location on the Hydian Way and the Shwuy Exchange, on several occasions the Uviuy Exen system was passed through by transiting [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along those hyperlanes. The [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] and exploration vessel ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' visited the system in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] on a shakedown cruise through the territory of the Galactic Republic. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] phase of the Clone Wars, [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleets]] chased Confederate forces [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], including along the Hydian Way through the Uviuy Exen system.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:DeathStar1-SWE.png|thumb|left|300px|The Death Star battlestation traveled through the Uviuy Exen system on its path to Alderaan.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several vessels involved with the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] traveled through the Uviuy Exen system. First, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] pursued the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] of the Rebel-aligned [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], between the Outer Rim worlds of [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Subsequently, the ''Devastator'', with the captive senator aboard, traveled back through Uviuy Exen to rendezvous with the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the Outer Rim's [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Shortly after that, when [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], decided to demonstrate its offensive capabilities upon the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] cleared the hyperlanes for the mobile [[Space station/Legends|station]] to move to its target unhindered, traveling through the Uviuy Exen system on its path. Finally, the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], whose crew possessed the [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematics for the Death Star]] and had [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescued Organa]] from the station in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]], raced through Uviuy Exen on its way to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on the Outer Rim [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TEA" />

The New Republic's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] passed through the Uviuy Exen system in 6 ABY while relocating<ref name="TEA" /> from its [[Talasea base|base]] on the<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> Colonies<ref name="TEA Talasea">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Morobe system]]</ref> planet [[Talasea]]<ref name="RS" /> to [[Noquivzor]], also in the Colonies. New Republic forces traveled through Uviuy Exen in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] before engaging the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] at [[Champala/Legends|Champala]] in the Chagri system, and again in [[27 ABY]] prior to a [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|confrontation]] with the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders at the Colonies world of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Uviuy Exen system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article written by [[Glen Allison]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' provided the first canonical mention of the Uviuy Exen system in the Legends continuity and placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> subsequently featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
